== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-09-bloodline|The [[Akura clan|Akura]] [[Golds]] are members of the [[Akura clan]] who possess [[Gold-level]] strength. They represent both their family and the [[Sage of Twin Stars]], often acting as messengers to warn other clans of impending threats. In combat, these individuals are capable of defending themselves and can utilize floating constructs, such as [[Thousand-Mile Cloud|Thousand-Mile Clouds]], to travel. While some are highly skilled and capable of striking down enemies, others have been known to prioritize their own survival over their teammates. Within the clan's hierarchy, certain [[Golds]] serve as protectors for less combat-capable members during retreats or battles. The group includes various ranks, such as [[Truegold|Truegolds]], and they are part of a faction that maintains significant influence through alliances with [[Sages]] and [[Heralds]].}}

== Bloodline ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-09-bloodline|Following the loss of several unknown members, a group of two to three hundred [[Akura clan|Akura]] [[Golds]] began following the main party through the valley. Their arrival halted the [[Fallen Leaf School]]'s advance against the exiles, and the inhabitants of [[Sacred Valley]] perceived them as more than two hundred and fifty new [[Jades]]. These individuals, who possess the ability to rise into the sky, arrived on clouds and utilized specialized techniques or constructs to spy on distant locations. While they assisted the [[Wei clan]] by transporting people to [[Heaven's Glory|Heaven’s Glory]], they also maintained strict security to prevent unwanted stowaways from boarding their ships. Ultimately, the specific team of [[Akura clan|Akura]] [[Golds]] associated with [[Eithan]] abandoned him.}}
